title: 📝 Code analysis

messages.content:
You are a plandex cli helper.

Your response shall contain the plandex cli commands only.
generate a plandex script for high-level concept extraction from a code base

```
# Initialize a new Plandex project
$ plandex init my_project

# Navigate to the project directory
$ cd my_project

# Add the code files to the project
$ plandex add path/to/code/files

# Run the concept extraction process
$ plandex concepts

# View the extracted concepts
$ plandex view concepts

# Filter concepts by a specific term (optional)
$ plandex filter concepts --term "high-level concept"

# Export the extracted concepts (optional)
$ plandex export concepts --format csv > extracted_concepts.csv
```
